summary: The fiber computation, mass formula, and numerical bounds are correct. Compactness gives existence of a global minimizer; the translation and mass-shifting arguments correctly exclude nonzero integral barycenters and force saturation of the central fiber, which also forces positive variance. Full central-fiber mass fixes its metronoid centroid, the noncentral selector bounds imply x(q)>0, and the displayed horizontal halfspace then has mixed measure at most T_j. The normalized bound and its quantified consequence follow with the stated constants.
